stages.name: The first idea
stages.line: The very first conversation, before any code existed.

stages.name: First board
stages.line: A board that tracks its own build: cards, columns, drag and drop, projects.

stages.name: Team and roles
stages.line: Agent profiles, team templates, spaces and who does what.

stages.name: Install and releases
stages.line: A zip a friend can install, self-updates, channels and roll back.

stages.name: Usage saver
stages.line: Measure what runs cost, keep the code lean, save your limit.

stages.name: Friends and sharing
stages.line: Private DMs, a scrambled relay, invites, roles and shared projects.

stages.name: Languages
stages.line: Every screen text in a language file, with Dutch and Flemish first.

stages.name: More languages
stages.line: 130 languages, and an immersion mode for learners.

stages.name: AI tester
stages.line: A tester checks every hand-over first and shows what it saw.

stages.name: The website
stages.line: aigile.lol, the teaser and this timeline.

stages.name: No AI edition
stages.line: A board for people who code without AI, and public boards.

stages.name: Servers and scale
stages.line: Global server settings, roles and planning for growth.

stages.name: Night watch
stages.line: A watchman and Scrum Master keep the teams on task while you sleep.

stages.name: Chat and streaming
stages.line: Discord, Twitch, OBS, streamer mode, GIFs and emojis.

stages.name: Streaming extras
stages.line: Twitch chat, custom emojis and a public live view.

stages.name: More AI engines
stages.line: Pick Claude, Codex, Gemini, Copilot or Cursor per agent.

stages.name: Pro practice
stages.line: Risk labels, merge gates, incident cards and guard rails.

planned.name: Phone and Android
planned.line: Reach your board from a phone, then a native Android app.

planned.name: Alpha and beyond
planned.line: Closed alpha, the live site, then beta.

planned.name: Everything else
planned.line: Smaller ideas still waiting their turn.
